description: Authenticated tool for listing open anomaly and delivery issues. Use q for smart lookup by anom_, dst_, evt_, or src_ IDs, or plain text like a status code or error message.

destinationId.description: Only include failed delivery issues for this destination ID.

limit.description: Maximum number of issues to return.

q.description: Smart query. Recognizes anom_, dst_, evt_, and src_ IDs as exact filters; otherwise matches issue text, kind, status, destination name, IDs, and response status.

sourceId.description: Only include issues for this source ID.

name: list_open_issues
title: List Open Issues
